metadata.question: Was the increase in nighttime light intensity from February 21, 2023, to April 30, 2023, greater in Antakya, the capital of Türkiye’s Hatay Province, than in Altınözü?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use VIIRS Nighttime Lights (VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG) for nighttime light intensity - Two time periods: February 21, 2023 and April 30, 2023 - Two locations: Antakya and Altınözü (both in Hatay Province, Turkey) - Note: Monthly data, so we'll need to use February 2023 and April 2023 2. Masking strategy: - VIIRS nighttime lights don't need cloud masking - Use the avg_rad band (average radiance) 3. Logic: - Calculate mean nighttime light for both cities in Feb 2023 and April 2023 - Calculate increase for each city: April - February - Compare increases: if Antakya increase > Altınözü increase, answer A; otherwise B - Check for C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (invalid results) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define geometries for Antakya and Altınözü const antakya = ee.Geometry.Point([36.1610, 36.2082]); // Antakya coordinates const altınozu = ee.Geometry.Point([36.2333, 36.0667]); // Altınözü coordinates // VIIRS Nighttime Lights collection const viirs = ee.ImageCollection('VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') .select('avg_rad'); // Get February 2023 data const feb2023 = viirs .filter(ee.Filter.date('2023-02-01', '2023-03-01')) .first(); // Get April 2023 data const apr2023 = viirs .filter(ee.Filter.date('2023-04-01', '2023-05-01')) .first(); // Check if images exist const febInfo = feb2023.getInfo(); const aprInfo = apr2023.getInfo(); if (!febInfo || !aprInfo) { console.log("No data found for one or both time periods."); console.log("C1"); return; } // Calculate mean nighttime light for Antakya const antakyaFeb = feb2023.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: antakya, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const antakyaApr = apr2023.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: antakya, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); // Calculate mean nighttime light for Altınözü const altinozuFeb = feb2023.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: altınozu, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const altinozuApr = apr2023.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: altınozu, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); // Check for null or invalid values if (antakyaFeb === null || antakyaApr === null || altinozuFeb === null || altinozuApr === null) { console.log("Calculation failed - null values returned."); console.log("C3"); return; } // Calculate increases const antakyaIncrease = antakyaApr - antakyaFeb; const altinozuIncrease = altinozuApr - altinozuFeb; // Print evidence console.log(`Antakya Feb 2023: ${antakyaFeb.toFixed(3)} nW/cm²/sr`); console.log(`Antakya Apr 2023: ${antakyaApr.toFixed(3)} nW/cm²/sr`); console.log(`Antakya Increase: ${antakyaIncrease.toFixed(3)}`); console.log(`Altınözü Feb 2023: ${altinozuFeb.toFixed(3)} nW/cm²/sr`); console.log(`Altınözü Apr 2023: ${altinozuApr.toFixed(3)} nW/cm²/sr`); console.log(`Altınözü Increase: ${altinozuIncrease.toFixed(3)}`); // Compare increases if (antakyaIncrease > altinozuIncrease) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
